Article 8 (Maintenance of Order)
(1) The Director may restrict entry to the Library by a person who is likely to threaten the safety of other users or disturb order in the Library.
(2) The Director may suspend the use of the Library by a user who has committed an act specified in any subparagraph of Article 7 or restrict the user's entry to the Library.
